ayat.arabic: قُلْ بِفَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ وَبِرَحْمَتِهِۦ فَبِذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَفْرَحُوا۟ هُوَ خَيْرࣱ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ ۝٥٨
ayat.translation: Say, "In the bounty of Allāh and in His mercy - in that let them rejoice; it is better than what they accumulate."

ayat.arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ ۝١٤
ayat.translation: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself

ayat.arabic: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ ۝١٥
ayat.translation: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.

ayat.arabic: ثُمَّ أَفِيضُوا۟ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَفَاضَ ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمࣱ ۝١٩٩
ayat.translation: Then depart from the place from where [all] the people depart and ask forgiveness of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

ayat.arabic: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَقُولُ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةࣰ وَفِي ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ حَسَنَةࣰ وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ۝٢٠١
ayat.translation: But among them is he who says, "Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire."

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ ۝١
ayat.translation: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muḥammad], al-Kawthar.

ayat.arabic: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ ۝٢
ayat.translation: So pray to your Lord and offer sacrifice [to Him alone].

ayat.arabic: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ ۝٣
ayat.translation: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ ۝١
ayat.translation: Indeed, We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down during the Night of Decree.

ayat.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ ۝٢
ayat.translation: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?

ayat.arabic: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرࣱ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرࣲ ۝٣
ayat.translation: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

ayat.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرࣲ ۝٤
ayat.translation: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.

ayat.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ هِيَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ ۝٥
ayat.translation: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِي لَيْلَةࣲ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ ۝٣
ayat.translation: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].

ayat.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلصِّيَامُ كَمَا كُتِبَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ ۝١٨٣
ayat.translation: O you who have believed, decreed upon you is fasting as it was decreed upon those before you that you may become righteous -

ayat.arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِۖ فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِي وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِي لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُونَ ۝١٨٦
ayat.translation: And when My servants ask you, [O Muḥammad], concerning Me - indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me. So let them respond to Me [by obedience] and believe in Me that they may be [rightly] guided.

ayat.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ ۝١
ayat.translation: Indeed, We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down during the Night of Decree.

ayat.arabic: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرࣱ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرࣲ ۝٣
ayat.translation: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

occasions.name: The Ten Days of Dhul Hijjah

ayat.arabic: وَٱلْفَجْرِ ۝١
ayat.translation: By the dawn

ayat.arabic: وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرࣲ ۝٢
ayat.translation: And [by] ten nights

ayat.arabic: وَأَذِّن فِي ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَجِّ يَأْتُوكَ رِجَالࣰا وَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ ضَامِرࣲ يَأْتِينَ مِن كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيقࣲ ۝٢٧
ayat.translation: And proclaim to the people the ḥajj [pilgrimage]; they will come to you on foot and on every lean camel; they will come from every distant pass -

ayat.arabic: قَالَ كَلَّآۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ ۝٦٢
ayat.translation: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."

ayat.arabic: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقࣲ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ ۝٦٣
ayat.translation: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.

ayat.arabic: إِذْ أَوَى ٱلْفِتْيَةُ إِلَى ٱلْكَهْفِ فَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةࣰ وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدࣰا ۝١٠
ayat.translation: [Mention] when the youths retreated to the cave and said, "Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance."

ayat.arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَلَمْ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عِوَجَاۜ ۝١
ayat.translation: [All] praise is [due] to Allāh, who has sent down upon His Servant [Muḥammad (ﷺ)] the Book and has not made therein any deviance.
